learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish weather from climate and name factors shaping climate
Explain the natural greenhouse effect and the carbon cycle
Describe how human activity increases greenhouse gases
Relate rising greenhouse gases to observed climate change
Evaluate simple mitigation and adaptation actions
Interpret climate data such as temperature and CO2 graphs

integrative_case: A coastal community faces hotter summers and higher tides: students separate weather from climate trends, use the greenhouse effect and carbon cycle to explain the warming, interpret local temperature and CO2 graphs, and recommend realistic mitigation and adaptation measures.
